label: GO step after a rewarded trial when the policy strongly prefers a1, in the first ~60 trials of an episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 100% of mass) and only when the agent is about to choose a1 with a very confident policy (choice logit in the top bin >8.07 holds 100% of mass; action==2 essentially never). Uses only observed variables plus the agent own policy output, no future outcomes. Base predicate (GO & prev_reward & choice>8.07) has recall ~1.0 but precision 0.49; the extra restriction ep_trial<60 lifts dev F1 to 0.80 (mass recall 0.95), because the unit fades over the episode (rate 7% at trials 10-19, ~0 after trial 80) -- a slow within-episode drift, not something the agent sees directly. It is stronger when S1 is the hidden good state (82% of mass) and in episodes that started with S1 good. Magnitude (from example windows): largest on the first rewarded a1 trial after an unrewarded one and decays across consecutive rewarded a1 trials (e.g. 1.00, 0.92, 0.79, 0.69, 0.60). Does not fire after unrewarded trials, before a2 choices, or late in episodes.
